bio: At this spacious brasserie, perfect for relaxed dining, a warm and welcoming atmosphere awaits. The wide-ranging à la carte selection and surprise menus draw on Dutch, French and Mediterranean influences. The dishes are hearty and satisfying, without being overly complicated. Options include al dente tagliatelle with prawns and a rich lobster bisque, perfectly seared ribeye steak with a robust red wine sauce, hasselback pumpkin, and tiramisu: the choices are seemingly endless! At this Bib Gourmand restaurant, incredible value for money is guaranteed....
